target.title: build: refresh Worker and Actions tooling
target.body:
## Summary

- refresh Worker formatting, linting, typechecking, and Wrangler tooling to current compatible stable releases
- pin `actions/checkout` v7.0.0 by immutable commit across CI workflows
- disambiguate Node's `URL` type from the Worker global type exposed by the refreshed definitions

Workers types v5 and Node types v26 remain deferred because the current Wrangler peer contract and Crabbox Node 22 runtime target do not support them.

## Verification

- `go vet ./...`
- `go test -race ./...`
- `scripts/test-go-modules.sh`
- `scripts/check-go-coverage.sh 90.0` (90.7%)
- `govulncheck ./...`
- Worker format, lint, typecheck, Vitest (830 passed, 2 skipped), and all build variants
- fresh Node 22 Docker build and runtime-start smoke
- `npm audit --prefix worker` (0 vulnerabilities)
- docs checks and 385 script tests
- AutoReview: clean, no actionable findings

This is a tooling/CI update with no provider or external runtime boundary, so no authenticated provider live call applies. The built Worker and fresh Node 22 container are the applicable artifact proof.

Public model identifier gate: PASS; no model-bearing surfaces changed. One random lockfile integrity substring matched a broad text scan and was classified as unrelated encoded checksum data.
